title: CSKA beat Khimki to repeat as champions
description: FINAL CSKA - Khimki 95-84 CSKA defended their VTB League title. They outgunned Khimki in the title game in Moscow tonight to claim the seventh straight League trophy. The game was mostly controlled by CSKA. Khimki managed to win third quarter 28-25. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They made 25-of-30 free shots (83.3 percent) during the game. CSKA looked well-organized offensively handing out 24 assists. 24 personal fouls committed by Khimki helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. French Nando De-Colo (196-87) fired 18 points and 7 assists (made all of his ten free throws !!!) for the winners. American swingman Cory Higgins (196-89, college: Colorado) chipped in 20 points and 4 steals.
